arguments.command:
echo "Subject: Meeting Request - Schedule Conflict

Dear [Recipient Name],

Thank you very much for your invitation to the meeting. I regret to inform you that due to prior commitments, I am unable to attend at the proposed time.

If possible, I would appreciate the opportunity to reschedule or to receive a summary of the meeting afterwards. Please let me know how you wish to proceed.

Thank you for your understanding.

Best regards,
[Your Name]" > email_draft.txt
